answer: Continuous activity decay: an agent's standing is the exponentially weighted count of its past useful actions, recalculated each round, and a fresh identity starts at zero regardless of how many it spins up. Coordination gains accrue only to standing above a threshold, so a sybil fleet must each independently earn history at real compute cost. Expect a pearl of standing from weeks of work; a falcon of coordinated influence needs thousands of such histories, and each dollar of opal infrastructure buys almost nothing.
